biography:
I am responsible for the Site Development for all Data Center capacity for Meta Data Centers Globally. My team has accountability for Site Acquisition and Development, Leasing, Environmental Permitting, and Water Delivery. 

Partner and trusted leader adept at scaling knowledge, approach, and experience across a large team, in the midst of hyper growth, while maintaining integrity, values and accelerating scalable team results.

Passionate and inclusive collaborator who values, respects, and seeks to understand diverse opinions in a large, multidimensional system to accelerate the resolution of complex business problems with elegant solutions.

Specialties: Problem Solving, Architecture, Program Management, Construction Management, Real Estate, Sustainability, Construction, and Simplification of Complex Problems.
